title: Chapter 92
text: It was only in the last fifty years that we realized they were no longer solely coming from the Barrens. They’d begun to take recruits, teaching those who never bonded a gryphon to channel what was not theirs to take, to upset the balance of magic by stealing it from the very source. The problem with mankind is we too often find our souls to be a fair price for power. —C APTAIN L ERA D ORRELL’S G UIDE TO V ANQUISHING THE V ENIN P ROPERTY OF C LIFFSBANE A CADEMY
